scenes.name: held diaper
scenes.source: Muse arms the watch, the hands hold a diaper: SAM 3.1 finds them, then the hover

scenes.name: both hands off
scenes.source: The hands come back, rest, then both leave: MediaPipe, the tone, then “hand”

scenes.name: one hand on
scenes.source: One hand rests on the baby: silent

scenes.name: hover 2.5 cm
scenes.source: One hand hovers 2.5 cm: SAM 3.1 hand masks and the lift check

scenes.name: done
scenes.source: “done, it was dirty”: Muse closes the watch, Baby Buddy read back

scenes.name: dog near the baby
scenes.source: SAM 3.1 dog and baby masks on the glasses frame
scenes.credit: Photo: Wang Yu Ching, Office of the President (Taiwan), CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons
